title: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Department of Energy relating to "Energy Conservation Program: Energy Conservation Standards for Consumer Gas-fired Instantaneous Water Heaters".
short_title: Repeal of the Department of Energy rule on Energy Conservation Program: Energy Conservation Standards for Consumer Gas-fire…
committees: S-Energy and Natural Resources Committee: Referred To 2025-01-23 -> Discharged From 2025-02-12
latest_action: Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 12.
summary: This joint resolution nullifies the rule titled Energy Conservation Program: Energy Conservation Standards for Consumer Gas-fired Instantaneous Water Heaters and submitted by the Department of Energy (DOE) on December 26, 2024. Under the rule, DOE adopted amended energy conservation standards for gas-fired instantaneous water heaters to achieve the maximum improvement in energy efficiency that DOE determined was technologically feasible and economically justified.

journey.note: Reported by committee; waiting for a floor vote
